project: Sailor Moon: Another Story (SNES) Static Recompilation
approach: Custom static recompilation into fixed native C bodies preserving exact execution contexts, with a native Windows frontend and target-owned SNES runtime.
notes: JRPG. Portable Windows 10/11 x64 release with keyboard and gamepad input, battery saves, snapshots and audio. Requires the Japan NTSC release with English translation patch v2.08; game data and patch are not included. Scoped gameplay and CI checks are not a complete playthrough certification.
